areas.text: A tropical wave located well to the south-southwest of the southern tip of the Baja California Peninsula is showing signs of organization. Environmental conditions appear conducive for additional development of this system, and a tropical depression is likely to form this weekend or early next week as it moves westward at at 10 to 15 mph across the western part of the East Pacific.

areas.area: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands
areas.text: Showers and thunderstorms continue in association with the remnants of Tropical Depression Fifteen-E. Environmental conditions appear only marginally conducive for some development of this system as it moves gradually westward, remaining east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands.

Disorganized showers and thunderstorms continue with a tropical wave located several hundred miles south of southern Mexico. Environmental conditions remain conducive for gradual development of this system, and a tropical depression is likely to form late this weekend or early next week while it moves gradually northwestward and then northward off the coast of southwestern Mexico.
